blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in Willoughby

items.t: Secondary suites + coach houses — the Township's own rules: Bylaw No. 2500 s.102 caps a secondary suite at a maximum gross floor area of 120 m²; each principal dwelling unit may have up to one secondary suite; a building permit is required for all suites. A coach house is defined in s.102 as an accessory dwelling unit located only within the second storey of a detached garage on a lot — a fee-simple second unit, never strata.

Servicing / STR / taxes: The Township does not issue business licences for short-term rental accommodations (per its own business-licence application conditions; Licencing Bylaw No. 5878). Township taxes and utility fees were due Thursday, July 2, 2026, 5% penalty at midnight July 2 and a further 5% at midnight September 3, 2026; utility fees are billed separately.

faq.q: Is there a named duplex or half-duplex project to shop in Willoughby?
faq.a: Willoughby duplex stock here is the form class — individual duplexes on single lots — inside a market whose verified depth is compact-lot detached houses with suites and the strata attached shelf.

faq.q: What lot sizes does the compact-lot zone allow?
faq.a: R-CL s.403: 220 m² minimum lot area to 464.5 m² maximum, frontage 11 m front-loaded / 8.2 m rear-loaded.

faq.q: How big can a suite or coach house be?
faq.a: A secondary suite is capped at 120 m² under s.102, one per principal unit, permit required. A coach house is the second storey of a detached garage only, fee-simple.

faq.q: The plan update — is it law yet?
faq.a: Price future form off the plans actually in force (Bylaw 6200, Schedule 6) until adoption is confirmed.
